posts.content_md:
[quote:5915fdbe51="Colin Kaminski"] During the last round of this I had contacted you all privately to try to resolve this. I even went out to dinner with Dinesh and Joy as well as talked to Danny on the phone. I also emailed all three of you repeatedly.

It is frustrating for me to get involved with this because posting anything to the forum simply continues the unhealthy path the three of you are on. Let me me be perfectly clear, from now on Micheal and I will delete posts that are not conducted in a Civil tone and email them back to the poster. The poster can then choose to edit them, discard them or forward them by direct email.

I did not start this forum so I could play Police Officer. Please stop putting me in the position of having to try to save the forum. This line of discussion can only harm the forum and your reputations. None of you are going to look better to any readers. While making a point makes you feel better it comes off like being the better pro-wrestler.

I don't want to pick sides in this publicly as I don't feel it is my place (not to mention that I like all three of you personally). Let's remember people that we are here to discuss holography and not debate the various skills of the participants. If you find someone who knows more about a subject than you, listen. If you know more about a subject than someone, teach. I often find that my students teach more than I could have ever known if I only listen to them. And a good teacher is worth their weight in gold.

I understand you are simply doing what feels right. I don't want to have to put a review policy on the forum. It is a very simple matter to make the forum delay all posts until a moderator aproves them.[/quote:5915fdbe51]

Thank you, Colin, for stating it in this neutral way without assigning the role of aggressor or aggressee to anyone.

Does this also mean there'll be no more name-calling of Liti.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
Just to be clear, I will use a theater review as an example. I once worked with an actress who did the lead in a show before I had met her and she got two reviews about her performance.

One stated that her performance was very week and distracting and the reviewer had a difficult time paying attention to her monologues.

The other stated that she should never be allowd on a stage again.

It isn't what was said but the tone of what was said that was hurtful. I wish I could say she we on to be a Tony award winning actress or something inspirational or something but she simply did a few more mediocre performances had a few kids and became a wonderful mother.

I don't have a problem with reviews but I do have a problem with the tone of some of the posts of late.
